verdict: Organic signals are softening; paid channels remain off across all three entities.
narrative: Across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals, all measurable activity this period came from Google Business Profile — no paid spend ran on Meta or Google Ads for any entity. Combined, your three profiles generated 361 GBP actions (directions, calls, and website clicks) over 25 active days, but engagement has been declining in the final week: GBP actions fell 36–41% week-over-week at AGS and O'Hare, and organic search clicks dropped sharply at Forte and AGS as well. The web and SEO root cause fix is in motion, with reindexing work targeting full recovery by end of October, which should stabilize and rebuild search visibility across all brands. Outreach sequences and CRM automation are on track for September and October milestones, which will add a direct-contact layer to what is currently a local-search-only pipeline.

watch_item.fix: The SEO root cause fix has been submitted and site reindexing is underway, targeting recovered impressions by end of October; lapsed outreach sequences are also being launched this month to open a parallel contact channel.
